<section id="about"><div class="two"><div>
<h2 class="h D">Welcome to the arena</h2>
<p>Exordium is the flagship sports event of <b>SIBM Bengaluru</b>, organised by the <b>Student Welfare &amp; Sports Committee (SWSC)</b>. Students across batches turn the campus into a hub of energy, competition and camaraderie.</p>
<p>The word means <i>a beginning or an opening</i>. This year, under the Apex Legends theme, the beginning is a drop: every match is a new fight, every victory a memory, and every participant a name in the legacy.</p>
<div class="vals"><div><b>Compete</b><span>Push your limits.</span></div><div><b>Collaborate</b><span>Trust your squad.</span></div><div><b>Challenge</b><span>Embrace every new opponent.</span></div><div><b>Conquer</b><span>Turn preparation into performance.</span></div></div></div>
<div class="panel"><h3 class="D" style="font-size:34px;margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--shield)">About SIBM-B</h3><p>Ever since its inception in 1971, Symbiosis has been synonymous with progress. It spread its wings with its first campus outside Maharashtra, in Bengaluru, in 2008.</p><a class="cta o" href="https://www.sibmbengaluru.edu.in/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Institute website</a></div></div>
